backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, defining data types (Member, FileData, LoginActivity, IdCardRequest) and CRUD operations for member registration, authentication, admin management, and ID card requests with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that MemberAuthProvider from useMemberAuth.tsx is wrapped around the RouterProvider inside App.tsx to make member authentication context available application-wide.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose, Hindi translations applied, and key functionality for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar) using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app titled 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', including Google site verification meta tag, AdSense script, and a root div mounting main.tsx.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Google AdSense ads.txt file declaring a direct relationship with publisher ID ca-pub-4905807488237044.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that defines all eleven TanStack Router routes (home, about, programs, philosophy, resources, contact, donate, admin, membership, login, dashboard) and wraps the RouterProvider with MemberAuthProvider for global auth context.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Hindi-translated quick links, contact details (email, two phone numbers, location), and social media icons (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, YouTube) with a copyright line.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component displaying the organization name, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi mission statement, and two CTA buttons (support mission and learn more) over a background image with gradient overlay.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that renders Navigation and Footer around an Outlet, providing consistent page structure for all routes.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four Hindi-titled core value cards (भक्ति, रक्षा, ज्ञान, एकता) with icons and descriptions, plus a section heading and introductory paragraph.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation bar with Hindi nav links, member login/logout controls, admin shield icon, and a mobile hamburger menu using TanStack Router and the useMemberAuth hook.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a Lucide icon, title, and description for a program entry with hover animation.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Renders a 2-column grid of four support option cards (volunteer, spread awareness, contribute skills, share knowledge) each linking to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated), initializes admin access control, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Hook managing contact form submission state; currently always returns an error since the backend submitContactForm endpoint has been removed.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook wrapping DFINITY AuthClient to manage ICP Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx: Context provider and hook for member authentication, handling login/logout via the backend actor and persisting the logged-in member ID in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemberQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for member-related backend operations including fetching members, ID card requests, login activities, and mutations for registration and ID card submission.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to check if the caller is an admin and to fetch the caller's user profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and defining a Sanatani-inspired saffron/warm OKLCH color palette via CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes, plus Tailwind base/component/utility layers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Renders the About page for KATTAR SANATANI YODHA with a hero section, organization story, and a grid of four core principles (mission, vision, values, community) using Lucide icons.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page that requires Internet Identity authentication and admin role, displaying tabbed views of all members, ID card requests, and login activities with search/filter controls.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form (name, email, phone, WhatsApp, message) that validates required fields and submits via useContactForm hook, alongside contact info and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation/support page showing support options via SupportOptions component, impact area breakdowns with progress bars, and a transparency commitment section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing Hero and Mission components with a highlights grid of four activity areas and a call-to-action section linking to donate and contact pages.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Member login page with email/phone and password fields that calls useMemberAuth's memberLogin and redirects to the dashboard on success, displaying validation and API errors.
frontend/src/pages/MemberDashboard.tsx: A protected member dashboard page that displays the logged-in member's profile information and allows them to request an ID card. Redirects to login if the user is not authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/Membership.tsx: A membership registration form page that collects personal details, location, gender, password, and file uploads (photo and Aadhaar card) to register a new member. Handles validation, file size checks, and submits data via the useRegisterMember hook.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: A static informational page presenting the philosophy and teachings of Sanatan Dharma, covering its eternal nature, unwavering devotion, and examples from Hindu scripture such as Ram, Hanuman, and Yudhishthira.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: A static page listing the organization's community programs (e.g., Vedic study circles, cultural festivals, youth education) displayed as cards, along with an impact statistics section.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: A static resources page that categorizes spiritual and educational materials (sacred texts, video lectures, articles, downloadable content) and highlights featured resources with external links.
frontend/src/utils/locationData.ts: Defines a `CountryData` interface and exports a `countriesData` array containing hierarchical location data (countries, states, districts) primarily for India, with Hindi/English names.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom color tokens (saffron, gold, etc.), custom fonts, extended border radii, box shadows, and animation keyframes using oklch color space.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state at version 3, describing a React web app with membership/auth features and recording that the root component tree has been wrapped with `MemberAuthProvider`.
